# U2: What needs me? Home shows what’s due, off track, stale or slipping

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `ATTENTION`, `PROFILES`, `STALE`
- **Budget:** at most 1 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `errors`, `logged` ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U2

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- _Note:_ Lane's notes (5 Nov): Home shows "Your goals" (what needs attention, what's being handled) and "Goals you watch".
- **Check:** “Your goals” is shown.
- **Check:** “N needs attention” is shown.
- _Note:_ Watching is a switch (SW1): with it off, Home has no “Goals you watch”.
- If the Watching module is on:
  - **Check:** “Goals you watch” is shown (else: home also shows the goals Rhea watches).
- Otherwise:
  - **Check:** It fails if Watching is off, but Home shows “Goals you watch”.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “home”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Check:** (`progress`) the ring in the hero (`.hero .ring`) is visible (else: no weekly progress ring).
- **Check:** It fails if expected an attention card for Rhea’s own goals.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `reasons.every((r) => r.trim().length > 20) && await p.locator('.arow[data-tone=risk] .arow-icon, .arow[data-tone=off] .arow-icon').count() > 0`, where `const cards = p.locator('.arow')`; `const reasons = await cards.locator('.arow-why').allInnerTexts()`. Else it says: attention rows lack a reason or a status icon.
- _Note:_ The first goal that needs attention starts on the first screen: its shape and title, with what needs your response above it (Lane, 5 Nov). Its reason is two lines on Home, and in full on the goal's page.
- **Check:** (`entry`) met when `top.y >= 0 && top.title != null && top.title <= top.fold - 8`, where `const cards = p.locator('.arow')`; `const top = await cards.first().evaluate((el) => { const bar = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tabbar')].find((e) => getComputedStyle(e).position === 'fixed' && e.getClientRects().length); const t = el.querySelector('.arow-title')?.getBoundingClientRect(); return { y: el.getBoundingClientRect().top, title: t ? t.bottom : null, fold: bar ? bar.getBoundingClientRect().top : innerHeight }; })`. Else it says: the first attention card's title ends at {Math.round(top.title ?? -1)}px, fold {Math.round(top.fold)}px.
- _Note:_ The word comes from a goal Rhea watches, so it is Watching's (SW1): with Watching off, Home has nothing late.
- If the Watching module is on:
  - **Check:** “late” is shown (else: an overdue check-in is called late).
- _Note:_ The north star is being handled (Amara looked at it in last week's review), so the first card is a goal already checked in; the week's check-in is the hero's one action.
- **Step.** Press the “Start check-in / Pick up where you left off” link in Home’s lead.
- **Check:** “What’s the number this week?” is shown.
- **Check:** (`finish`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
